name: CLIP: Learning Transferable Visual Models (arXiv:2103.00020)
notes: ICML 2021. CLIP ViT-L/14 (the vision tower used in original LLaVA) has ~304M parameters. At 224x224, CLIP ViT-L/14 costs ~17.5 GFLOPs per image. The paper does not report FLOPs directly; this figure is from the OpenCLIP repo and standard ViT FLOP calculations.
